name: 993 center cap, AlSi10Mg F0 concept without crest
description: Independent concept of a metal center cap with four integrated tabs to screen a small LPBF series. PorscheFanatics confirms the identity and the historical PET status; partworks publishes three dimensions and states that the original is plastic.

classification.intended_use: CAD, clip-fit, centrifugal, thermal and DfAM screening; no road fitting authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the neutral concept, the script and the calculations; no crest, logo, photograph or commercial model redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - historical register of superseded part numbers
sources.notes: Identifies 993 361 303 07 as a hub cap with historical PET status U; current availability remains unknown there. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-WHEEL-CENTER-CAP-STATUS.

sources.title: partworks - original 993 center cap
sources.notes: Declares plastic, outer diameter 76 mm, inner diameter 60 mm and height 46 mm. These values are a commercial envelope, not the definition of the clips. See SRC-PARTWORKS-993-WHEEL-CENTER-CAP-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg material data sheet
sources.notes: Process and composition reference only; the F0 mechanical constants are generic. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-CURRENT-PAGE.

material.grade: AlSi10Mg for screening; commercial original declared as plastic
material.standard: ASTM F3318 to be contracted if the metal route survives testing

post_processing: support removal with an open interior volume
heat treatment qualified to preserve tab flexibility
finishing of clip surfaces and edges
front face left neutral with no Porsche marking
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
bending coupon in the tab orientation
CT or radiographic inspection of the tab roots
dimensional inspection of the ring and the four clips
contracted roughness, radii, porosity and fatigue
insertion, pull-out, rotation, impact and thermal cycling tests

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Aluminum compatibility of the cap, actual wheel alloy, coating and salt environment to be qualified.

known_limits: Only Ø76, Ø60, 46 mm height and plastic come from the commercial record; all interfaces are hypothetical.
Replacing plastic with AlSi10Mg changes mass, compliance, fatigue and corrosion; no equivalence is claimed.
The 0.4 mm, 0.30 coefficient, 250 km/h, 20 g and +120 K cases are synthetic.
The model includes no Porsche emblem, crest or design.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP and must not be installed on a wheel.
